clue.text: "Sun" follows this year's compulsive bed-hopper

parts.note: Sunday follows Saturday, so the day this describes is Saturday, abbreviated SAT
YR is the standard abbreviation for year

explanation.surface: A tabloid newspaper follows the year's most notorious philanderer.
explanation.walkthrough: "Sun" looks like the newspaper or the star, but it is short for Sunday, and the day it follows is Saturday.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth these goat-legged woodland gods were lustful, so the word now names a man obsessed with sexual conquest.

clue.text: Falter with asinine witticism when drunk?

indicators.note: a drunk slurs his esses, so the phrase as he would say it turns every S into SH

parts.note: asinine means silly, and a sally is a witty retort

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles over a stupid joke after a few drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when drunk' asks for SILLY SALLY as a drunk would pronounce it, every S slurred to SH.
explanation.definitionFit: To hesitate and fail to make up one's mind is to vacillate, the same idea as faltering.

clue.text: Half-cut, Tony Blair's wife hides £50 where payment is due

indicators.note: the wife's name with the first fragment conceals the money inside it
cutting the name in half leaves just its first two letters

parts.note: Tony Blair's wife is Cherie Booth, her maiden and professional name
L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A tipsy Cherie Blair stashes a fifty-pound note somewhere it's owed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half-cut' looks like drunk but asks for half of the first name; Cherie Booth kept her maiden name professionally, and 'hides' puts both money letters inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A booth at a road or bridge where drivers stop to hand over a toll charge.

clue.text: Bishop holds good service, one that flies by

indicators.note: the bishop's title surrounds the tennis term, holding it inside

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
an ace is an unreturnable serve in tennis

explanation.surface: A bishop presides over a fine church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' suggests worship, but here it is a tennis serve.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something built for speed goes past at high velocity, such as a fast car or cyclist.

clue.text: Break down without cover for Skoda vehicle? Correct!

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the breakdown word goes round the rest

parts.note: a machine that breaks down is said to die

indicators.note: the cover of a word is its outer pair of letters, first and last

parts.note: a bus is a public road vehicle

explanation.surface: A Skoda driver who breaks down without breakdown cover is told off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover' looks like insurance, but it takes the outside letters of Skoda, SA.
explanation.definitionFit: To free someone of a mistaken belief is to put them right, an imperative here.

clue.text: Strips down and regularly does gentle exercise

indicators.note: taking every other letter of the word, first and third

parts.note: Pilates is a low-impact exercise system for core strength

explanation.surface: Someone undresses and does a little light exercise every week.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strips down' suggests undressing; here it means removing body hair, the down.
explanation.definitionFit: Removing hair from the skin, as by waxing, takes away the fine down.

clue.text: We're told the coast is clear

indicators.note: something we are told is heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: the coast is the shore, the edge of the land by the sea

explanation.surface: A lookout reports that there's nobody about.
explanation.definitionFit: Being certain about a matter means it is clear in your mind, beyond doubt.

clue.text: Man, lousy bum, gin's making insensitive

parts.note: Ben is a man's name, standing for any man

indicators.note: lousy as in bad or worthless, telling us the letters are in poor order

parts.note: the possessive adds no letter

explanation.surface: A worthless drunkard's gin habit is deadening his feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: To numb something is to deprive it of feeling, making it unresponsive.

clue.text: More self-conscious person having a fling?

definitions.meaning: one who shies, that is, throws or flings something

explanation.surface: A rather timid soul embarks on an affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fling' looks like a brief affair, but a shy is a throw, so one who throws is one who shies.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of an adjective for timidity, and also the agent noun of the verb to throw in its sense of toss.

clue.text: Listen, Picaroon needs treating like a caring person

indicators.note: the letters need to be worked on and reprocessed into a new order

explanation.surface: Hear me out: the setter is in need of medical care.
explanation.walkthrough: Picaroon is the setter's own pseudonym, used here as plain letters.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin phrase means acting in the place of a parent, taking on a guardian's responsibility.

clue.text: Subdued Balls and Miliband welcoming upright head of state

indicators.note: the outer pair takes the other pieces into its middle

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls
Ed Miliband, the Labour leader
a mast is an upright pole
ER, Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Ed Balls and Ed Miliband are brought to heel after taking in a statesman.
explanation.walkthrough: Ed Balls and Ed Miliband are both Labour politicians called Ed, but Balls gives OVER, a cricket term for six balls bowled.
explanation.definitionFit: To overcome or conquer is to bring under control, a synonym for subdue in the past.

clue.text: Ballsier, free progressives

indicators.note: the letters are set free to move into another order

explanation.surface: Bolder, liberated reformers.
explanation.definitionFit: Supporters of reform and personal freedom in politics are broad-minded progressives.

clue.text: Polish rejecting English entertainment

indicators.note: rejecting means casting out the letter for English

parts.note: to polish something is to improve it

explanation.surface: A Polish performer rejects an English show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' with a capital looks like the nationality, but is the verb to polish.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for improvisation, comedy or theatre made up on the spot as a form of show.

clue.text: Two items of clothing for person in field

parts.note: shorts are short trousers
a top is an upper-body garment

explanation.surface: A farm worker is given a couple of garments to wear.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'field' is a baseball field, not a farm.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball this is a fielder stationed between second and third base.

clue.text: Rubbish penned by cryptic setter — it should make you think

indicators.note: penned by means enclosed within the other letters
cryptic means obscure or puzzling, telling us the letters are disguised

parts.note: pap is worthless or trivial material

explanation.surface: A crossword compiler writes nonsense that's meant to be thought-provoking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cryptic' turns setter into TESTER, which encloses PAP.
explanation.definitionFit: An exam paper is set to challenge and assess a candidate's reasoning.

clue.text: Forced to admit routine is rehearsed

indicators.note: to admit means to let in, so the routine goes inside

parts.note: prised means forced open with a lever
an act is a routine performed by an entertainer

explanation.surface: Someone is coerced into confessing that a set routine has been practised.
explanation.definitionFit: Something practised repeatedly before a performance has been gone over in preparation.

clue.text: Italian footballers spend cold months without women

indicators.note: without means minus the letter for women

parts.note: to winter is to spend the cold season somewhere

explanation.surface: Italian players pass the cold season with no female company.
explanation.definitionFit: Inter Milan, Internazionale, is a leading Italian football club.

clue.text: Dogs consuming bit of fruit — beginning to eat, they expel gas in America

indicators.note: consuming means swallowing the other letters inside

parts.note: to dog someone is to tail or follow them
a pip is a seed, a small bit of a fruit

indicators.note: the beginning of the word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Dogs eat some fruit and then suffer from wind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dogs' is the verb to follow, not the animals.
explanation.definitionFit: The American term for exhaust pipes at the back of a vehicle, venting fumes.

clue.text: Tennis champ's trophy

definitions.meaning: belonging to Arthur Ashe, the Wimbledon champion of 1975
the urn contested in England v Australia cricket

explanation.surface: A tennis champion's silverware.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ashes are the cricket Test series between England and Australia, played for a tiny urn.
explanation.definitionFit: Possessive of a tennis player's name, and the name of a famous sporting prize.

clue.text: Nirvana's rock, blaring, has kicking intro

indicators.note: to rock is to shake about, so the letters are disturbed
kicking out its opening letter

explanation.surface: The band Nirvana's loud rock music opens with a kick.
explanation.walkthrough: Nirvana looks like the grunge band; the words after 'rock' are the fodder, LARING and HAS.
explanation.definitionFit: The paradise of the novel Lost Horizon became a byword for an earthly paradise, a perfect bliss.

clue.text: Doctors put elementary wrapping around breaks

indicators.note: around means turned round, read backwards
the three words wrap the answer inside them

explanation.surface: Doctors apply basic bandaging around fractures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks' looks like fractures for the doctors, but means pauses.
explanation.definitionFit: Pauses or lulls in activity, when pressure eases off for a while.

clue.text: It's said tea garden borders a US lake

indicators.note: the two outer pieces border the little word between them
the drink, said aloud, is the name of the letter T

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like T
to hoe is to garden, weeding with a hoe

explanation.surface: Tea garden borders are being described.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Tahoe sits in the Sierra Nevada on the California and Nevada border.

clue.text: Pan what a drug supplier may do

definitions.meaning: a large cooking vessel for making broth

definitions.text: what a drug supplier may do
definitions.meaning: a dealer may ..., that is keep cannabis in stock

explanation.surface: A dealer's kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep cooking pan in which stock is simmered, and also the phrase for keeping marijuana on hand.

clue.text: Don't go with change, defending Latin

indicators.note: defending means guarding by surrounding the letter

parts.note: change, as in coins, is cash

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to change their stance while defending Latin.
explanation.definitionFit: Colours that fail to match each other are said to jar together.

clue.text: Fuel very Marxist uprising

indicators.note: uprising, in a down clue, means read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a red is a communist

explanation.surface: A very Marxist revolution needs fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: DERV is the British name for diesel fuel for road vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: Diesel oil for road vehicles goes by this British name, from diesel-engined road vehicle.

clue.text: Cheeky sort of paparazzo pursuing person tanning

indicators.note: pursuing means coming after, so the photographer goes second

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to whip them
a paparazzo is a press photographer, a snapper

explanation.surface: A cheeky photographer pursues someone sunbathing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tanning' looks like sunbathing but means beating.
explanation.definitionFit: An impertinent young person, typically one presumptuous beyond their years.

clue.text: Carpeted with soft design over boring crimson

indicators.note: boring means drilling into the colour word

parts.note: crimson is a red
P is piano, soft in music

indicators.note: to design is to arrange, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A floor was carpeted with a soft pattern laid across a dull red.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carpeted' looks like floor covering but means scolded.
explanation.definitionFit: To be carpeted is to be called in and rebuked by a superior.

clue.text: Member of religious sect can prove who he is

parts.note: has, in the sense of being in possession
ID, identification, proves identity

explanation.surface: A sect member is able to show his identity.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a statement: someone who can prove who he is has ID.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of Hasidism, a strictly orthodox Jewish movement.
